pi-server-handshake-unref.reason: Server.accept calls unref() on its handshake timer, but browser setTimeout returns a number, so every connection in a worker throws. applyPatches() wraps accept so the timer id gets no-op unref and ref methods.
pi-server-handshake-unref.removeWhen: pi-server stops calling unref() on timers, or guards the call.

pi-server-node-crypto.reason: The session router imports randomUUID from node:crypto. In SLICC the bios service worker serves a node:crypto stub backed by globalThis.crypto; the integration bundles alias it to test/integration/shims/node-crypto.js.
pi-server-node-crypto.removeWhen: pi-server uses globalThis.crypto.randomUUID instead of node:crypto.
